title: Myotome Screening — Which Root Is Weak?

hook.en: Ten quick resisted holds tell you which spinal root is struggling. Learn the myotome ladder, the disc rule and how to avoid the classic "pain looks like weakness" trap.
hook.ur: Das tez resisted holds batate hain ke kaun si spinal root takleef mein hai. Myotome ki seerhi, disc ka qaida aur “dard kamzori jaisa lagta hai” wali classic ghalti se bachna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll name the key muscle for each root from C5 to S1, screen all myotomes in a few minutes, and use the disc rule to predict which root a disc will hit.
goal.ur: End tak aap C5 se S1 tak har root ka key muscle batayenge, chand minutes mein saare myotomes screen karenge, aur disc rule se andaza lagayenge ke disc kaun si root ko dabayegi.

text.en: A **myotome** is the group of muscles supplied by one spinal root. Almost every muscle gets fibres from two or three roots, so the myotome map names the **key muscle** that depends most on each root. You test it with a **resisted isometric hold**: "Hold — don't let me move you" for about 5 seconds in mid-range. Weakness of one myotome points to that root (or the nerve that carries it).
text.ur: **Myotome** un muscles ka group hai jinhein ek spinal root supply karti hai. Taqreeban har muscle ko do ya teen roots se fibres milte hain, is liye myotome map har root ka **key muscle** batata hai jo sab se zyada us par depend karta hai. Aap isay **resisted isometric hold** se test karte hain: “Hold karein — mujhe move nahi karne dena”, mid-range mein takriban 5 seconds. Ek myotome ki kamzori us root (ya us nerve jo usay le jati hai) ki taraf ishara karti hai.

text.en: Think of a fuse box. Each fuse (root) powers a group of lamps (muscles). If the C7 fuse trips, the lamps that depend on it — the triceps and wrist flexors — flicker, while the C5 and C6 lamps stay bright. Finding which lamps are dim tells you which fuse to check.
text.ur: Fuse box ka tasawwur karein. Har fuse (root) lamps ke ek group (muscles) ko bijli deta hai. Agar C7 ka fuse urr jaye to jo lamps us par hain — triceps aur wrist flexors — jhilmilate hain, jabke C5 aur C6 ke lamps roshan rehte hain. Kaun se lamps dheemay hain, yeh batata hai ke kaun sa fuse dekhna hai.

text.en: **The ladder.** Arm: **C5** shoulder abduction, **C6** elbow flexion + wrist extension, **C7** elbow extension + wrist flexion, **C8** finger flexion, **T1** finger abduction. Leg: **L2** hip flexion, **L3** knee extension, **L4** ankle dorsiflexion, **L5** big-toe extension, **S1** ankle plantarflexion (and hip extension). Say it from neck to foot, out loud, three times.
text.ur: **Seerhi.** Arm: **C5** shoulder abduction, **C6** elbow flexion + wrist extension, **C7** elbow extension + wrist flexion, **C8** finger flexion, **T1** finger abduction. Leg: **L2** hip flexion, **L3** knee extension, **L4** ankle dorsiflexion, **L5** bare angootay ki extension, **S1** ankle plantarflexion (aur hip extension). Isay gardan se paaon tak zor se, teen baar bolein.

intro.en: Watch the C5 test: the arm is held out and the examiner presses down. Pause at the hold, switch sides and notice where the examiner's hand sits.
intro.ur: C5 test dekhein: arm bahar rakha hai aur examiner neeche dabata hai. Hold par pause karein, side badlein aur dekhein ke examiner ka haath kahan hai.

question.en: A patient cannot hold the shoulder out against resistance, but the elbow bends and wrist extends normally. Which root is the first suspect?
question.ur: Patient shoulder ko resistance ke khilaf bahar hold nahi kar sakta, lekin elbow flexion aur wrist extension normal hain. Pehla shak kis root par?

feedback.en: Yes — shoulder abduction is the C5 key muscle (deltoid, supraspinatus). Elbow flexion and wrist extension are C6 and are spared.
feedback.ur: Haan — shoulder abduction C5 ka key muscle hai (deltoid, supraspinatus). Elbow flexion aur wrist extension C6 hain aur theek hain.

feedback.en: C7 is elbow extension and wrist flexion, which are normal here.
feedback.ur: C7 elbow extension aur wrist flexion hai, jo yahan normal hain.

feedback.en: C8 is finger flexion; the question says the hand moves normally.
feedback.ur: C8 finger flexion hai; sawal mein haath normal hai.

title.en: How to screen myotomes in 3 minutes
title.ur: 3 minute mein myotomes kaise screen karein

steps.title: Position and explain
steps.detail: Sit the patient for the arm tests and lie them supine for the leg tests. Say "Hold — don't let me move you" and demonstrate. || Position aur wazahat

steps.title: Put the joint in mid-range
steps.detail: Isometric holds in mid-range are comfortable and reproducible; do not push into end of range where pain or joint locking changes the answer. || Joint ko mid-range mein rakhein

steps.title: Build force slowly
steps.detail: Ramp up over 2–3 seconds and hold for about 5 seconds. A sudden jab makes everyone look weak. || Force aahista barhayein

steps.title: Compare sides, then repeat
steps.detail: Always test the other side. If the answer is borderline, repeat 3–5 times — a root lesion often weakens with repetition. || Sides compare karein, phir repeat karein

steps.title: Use function for big muscles
steps.detail: Quadriceps and calf are too strong to break by hand. Use single-leg squat, heel raises, heel walking and toe walking instead. || Bare muscles ke liye function use karein

intro.en: The L5 test is a small movement: the great toe is lifted against the examiner's finger. Watch the toe, then compare both sides.
intro.ur: L5 test chhoti si movement hai: bara angootha examiner ki finger ke khilaf upar uthta hai. Angootha dekhein, phir dono sides compare karein.

text.en: **Pain looks like weakness.** A painful knee will "test weak" for L3 because pain inhibits muscle. If the patient grimaces, stop, note it, and look for a pattern across several myotomes instead of trusting one. Another trap is testing a muscle in a stretched or shortened position, which makes a normal muscle look weak.
text.ur: **Dard kamzori jaisa lagta hai.** Dard wala knee L3 ke liye “kamzor” test hoga kyunke dard muscle ko inhibit karta hai. Agar patient munh bigare to ruk jayein, note karein, aur ek par bharosa karne ke bajaye kayi myotomes ka pattern dekhein. Ek aur jaal: muscle ko stretched ya shortened position mein test karna, jis se normal muscle bhi kamzor lagta hai.

title.en: Which root does the disc hit?
title.ur: Disc kaun si root ko maarti hai?

rows.en: The root exits above its vertebra, so a disc usually hits the root of the lower number
rows.ur: Root apni vertebra ke upar se nikalti hai, is liye disc aam taur par neechay wale number ki root ko dabati hai

rows.en: A posterolateral disc compresses the traversing root, passing down to exit one level lower
rows.ur: Posterolateral disc guzarti (traversing) root ko dabati hai jo ek level neeche nikalti hai

rows.en: L4–L5 disc → L5 root; L5–S1 disc → S1 root
rows.ur: L4–L5 disc → L5 root; L5–S1 disc → S1 root

rows.en: A far-lateral disc can hit the exiting root instead
rows.ur: Far-lateral disc exiting root ko bhi maar sakti hai

question.en: A man with right leg pain has weak big-toe extension and numbness over the top of the foot. Which disc is the most likely culprit?
question.ur: Right leg ke dard wale aadmi mein bare angootay ki extension kamzor hai aur foot ka top sunn hai. Sab se mumkin disc kaun si?

text.ur: L4–L5 posterolateral disc (L5 ko dabati hui)

feedback.en: Yes — big-toe extension and the dorsum of the foot are both L5, and an L4–L5 disc compresses the traversing L5 root.
feedback.ur: Haan — bare angootay ki extension aur foot ka dorsum dono L5 hain, aur L4–L5 disc traversing L5 root ko dabati hai.

feedback.en: An L5–S1 disc compresses S1 (outer foot, calf weakness, absent ankle jerk).
feedback.ur: L5–S1 disc S1 ko dabati hai (outer foot, calf ki kamzori, ankle jerk gayab).

feedback.en: The question describes the leg; cervical discs affect the arm.
feedback.ur: Sawal taang ka hai; cervical discs arm ko affect karti hain.

text.en: **Use the triad.** A root lesion shows up as weakness of the myotome, numbness in the dermatome **and** a changed reflex at the same level. Two out of three matching the same level is convincing. Write it down: "R L5: EHL 3/5, reduced sensation dorsum of the foot, medial hamstring reflex normal." Re-test at every visit — recovery of power is your best sign that the root is improving.
text.ur: **Triad use karein.** Root lesion myotome ki kamzori, dermatome ki numbness **aur** usi level ke reflex ki tabdeeli ke taur par nazar aati hai. Teen mein se do ka ek hi level se match karna convincing hai. Likh lein: “R L5: EHL 3/5, foot ke dorsum par sensation kam, medial hamstring reflex normal.” Har visit par dobara test karein — taqat ka wapas aana is baat ki behtareen nishani hai ke root behtar ho rahi hai.

question.en: A patient has foot drop. How do you tell an **L5 root** problem from a **common fibular nerve** palsy at the fibular neck?
question.ur: Patient ko foot drop hai. **L5 root** ka masla aur fibular neck par **common fibular nerve** ki palsy mein farq kaise karein?

answer.en: Test muscles that share the root but not the nerve: **hip abduction** (superior gluteal, L4–S1) and **ankle inversion** (tibialis posterior, tibial nerve, L4–L5). If those are weak too, it is the L5 root; if they are normal and only dorsiflexion and eversion are weak, it is the common fibular nerve.
answer.ur: Aise muscles test karein jo root share karte hain magar nerve nahi: **hip abduction** (superior gluteal, L4–S1) aur **ankle inversion** (tibialis posterior, tibial nerve, L4–L5). Agar yeh bhi kamzor hon to L5 root; agar yeh normal hon aur sirf dorsiflexion aur eversion kamzor hon to common fibular nerve.

question.en: Foot drop, weak hip abduction and weak inversion. Where is the lesion?
question.ur: Foot drop, kamzor hip abduction aur kamzor inversion. Lesion kahan hai?

feedback.en: Yes — three different nerves are affected, but they share the L5 root.
feedback.ur: Haan — teen mukhtalif nerves affected hain, lekin teeno ka root L5 hai.

text.en: Common fibular nerve at the fibular head
text.ur: Fibular head par common fibular nerve

feedback.en: That nerve would spare hip abduction and inversion.
feedback.ur: Woh nerve hip abduction aur inversion ko mehfooz rakhti hai.

feedback.en: A sciatic lesion would also weaken the hamstrings and plantarflexion, and would not touch hip abduction.
feedback.ur: Sciatic lesion hamstrings aur plantarflexion ko bhi kamzor karti, aur hip abduction ko nahi chhoti.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for rapidly progressive weakness, weakness in both legs, new loss of bladder or bowel control, or numbness around the saddle area — these suggest cauda equina or cord compression. A single weak muscle that is slowly improving is a very different picture from weakness that is worse today than yesterday.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar kamzori tezi se barh rahi ho, dono taangon mein ho, bladder ya bowel control mein nayi kami ho, ya saddle area sunn ho — yeh cauda equina ya cord compression ke ishare hain. Ek kamzor muscle jo aahista behtar ho raha ho, us kamzori se bohat mukhtalif tasveer hai jo aaj kal se zyada bigar gayi ho.

summary.en: A myotome is the key muscle of one root: test it with a 5-second resisted isometric hold in mid-range and compare sides.
summary.ur: Myotome ek root ka key muscle hai: usay mid-range mein 5-second resisted isometric hold se test karein aur sides compare karein.

summary.en: Learn the ladder C5 → S1 and the disc rule (cervical hits the lower number, lumbar hits the traversing root).
summary.ur: Seerhi C5 → S1 aur disc rule yaad karein (cervical neechay wale number ko, lumbar traversing root ko maarti hai).

summary.en: Name the root only when myotome, dermatome and reflex agree; pain inhibits muscle and progressive or bilateral weakness needs urgent referral.
summary.ur: Root ka naam tab lein jab myotome, dermatome aur reflex ek hi level par agree karein; dard muscle ko inhibit karta hai aur barhti hui ya dono taraf ki kamzori urgent refer chahiye.

front.en: C5, C6, C7, C8, T1 myotomes?
front.ur: C5, C6, C7, C8, T1 ke myotomes?

back.en: Shoulder abduction; elbow flexion + wrist extension; elbow extension + wrist flexion; finger flexion; finger abduction.
back.ur: Shoulder abduction; elbow flexion + wrist extension; elbow extension + wrist flexion; finger flexion; finger abduction.

front.en: L2, L3, L4, L5, S1 myotomes?
front.ur: L2, L3, L4, L5, S1 ke myotomes?

back.en: Hip flexion; knee extension; ankle dorsiflexion; big-toe extension; ankle plantarflexion.
back.ur: Hip flexion; knee extension; ankle dorsiflexion; bare angootay ki extension; ankle plantarflexion.

front.en: An L4–L5 posterolateral disc compresses which root?
front.ur: L4–L5 posterolateral disc kaun si root dabati hai?

back.en: L5 (the traversing root). A far-lateral disc at the same level can hit the exiting L4 root.
back.ur: L5 (traversing root). Isi level ki far-lateral disc exiting L4 root ko maar sakti hai.

front.en: How do you separate an L5 root lesion from a common fibular nerve palsy?
front.ur: L5 root lesion aur common fibular nerve palsy mein farq kaise karein?

back.en: Test hip abduction and ankle inversion: weak = L5 root; normal = common fibular nerve.
back.ur: Hip abduction aur ankle inversion test karein: kamzor = L5 root; normal = common fibular nerve.

goDeeper.title: Myotomes skill in the Skills Lab

note.en: Watch every myotome test in 3D on both sides.
note.ur: Har myotome test 3D mein dono sides par dekhein.

note.en: Combine all three into the root triad.
note.ur: Teeno ko mila kar root triad banayein.
